name: Bad Romance
source:
When the prison walls fall, so do the rules. Trapped with dangerously hot villains, our hero must seduce to survive – and embrace their most scandalous powers.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当监狱的围墙倒塌时，规则也会随之倒塌。我们的英雄被危险的恶棍困住，必须引诱才能生存，并拥抱他们最可耻的力量。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
